scripts.wgo: go generate && cross-env CLICOLOR_FORCE=1 LOG=ln wgo
scripts.air: go generate && cross-env CLICOLOR_FORCE=1 LOG=ln air
scripts.test: go generate && cross-env CLICOLOR_FORCE=1 LOG=ln go run .
scripts.build_docker: VERSION=${VERSION:-$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 | sed 's/^v//')} && curl -fSL https://github.com/McHauge/mediamtx-path-viewer/releases/download/v${VERSION}/mediamtx-path-viewer_${VERSION}_linux_amd64.tar.gz | tar -xzf - mediamtx-path-viewer && docker build --build-arg VERSION=${VERSION} -t mchauge/mediamtx-path-viewer:stable . && rm -f mediamtx-path-viewer
scripts.build_docker_beta: VERSION=${VERSION:-$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 | sed 's/^v//')} && curl -fSL https://github.com/McHauge/mediamtx-path-viewer/releases/download/v${VERSION}/mediamtx-path-viewer_${VERSION}_linux_amd64.tar.gz | tar -xzf - mediamtx-path-viewer && docker build --build-arg VERSION=${VERSION} -t mchauge/mediamtx-path-viewer:beta . && rm -f mediamtx-path-viewer
